messages:
sara-k: quick follow-up from the postmortem - auth provider token throttling caused model-registry write errors and delayed deployments. we sketched fixes in the doc but need owners + clear ETAs. posting proposed items.

vikas-p: thanks. timeline recap: incident started 02:50 UTC, mitigation at 03:22, full recovery 03:40. pattern: provider maintenance windows + concurrent bulk deploys.

oncall-lee: read path mostly ok; writes retried and created a backlog which increased DB pressure. manual suppression helped.

sara-k: proposed action list (reply with owner + ETA):
- provider maintenance visibility + contract escalation -> owner: ? -> ETA: 2w
- multi-provider token failover + health probe -> owner: vikas-p -> ETA: 3w
- registry write-queue with async apply (best-effort) -> owner: vikas-p -> ETA: 2w
- SDK-level retry + jitter + read-only cached-token behavior -> owner: vikas-p -> ETA: 1w
- alerting: token-error-rate > 5% for 5m -> owner: oncall-lee -> ETA: 3d
- runbook/deploy gating for provider maintenance -> owner: oncall-lee -> ETA: EOW
- customer comms playbook snippet -> owner: legal-anna -> ETA: 1w

vikas-p: taking failover + SDK + queue. will land SDK retry PR tomorrow, queue prototype in 1w, full rollout in 2w. will add failover plan draft by end of week.

oncall-lee: will own alerts + runbook updates. will add a deploy gate to pipeline to prevent large deploys during provider maintenance windows. ETA Friday.

legal-anna: will draft the customer-facing playbook and start vendor escalation re: maintenance calendar and SLA. ETA 2w for vendor reply, playbook PR in 1w.

ops-bot: created INC-5910 - "auth-token-failover & registry resilience" assigned to vikas-p, oncall-lee. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5910

sara-k: two extra asks: 1) monthly incident review for auth-related incidents to check recurrence trends -> owner: oncall-lee? 2) short incident TL;DR for PMs to coordinate roadmap changes -> owner: sara-k?

oncall-lee: I can own the monthly review and build a small dashboard: token-error-rate, registry-write-fail-rate. creating INC-5911.

sara-k: I'll take the PM-facing TL;DR and share with product leads.

vikas-p: agreed priority: multi-provider failover + vendor visibility should be top. will mark INC-5910 as P0 and break into subtasks.

legal-anna: vendor contact acknowledged escalation. will post updates when received.

sara-k: thanks all. quick sync Monday 09:30 to confirm blockers. if you reassign, update INC-5910 or reply here. :thumbsup:
